subject: SIG initiation & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope — next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG initiation & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope — next steps

Hi Asha — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to get us kicked off on the security questionnaire so your team can move toward procurement.

Recap / context:
- ClearHealth will be the initial integration customer for our Clinical Summaries API.
- Key compliance asks you called out: SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA BAA, and encryption/key management details; potential GDPR residency considerations for EU users.

What we can provide now:
- SOC 2 summary (latest Type II report is in progress; we have a 2026 scope summary and control map).
- BAA: we can sign a BAA — will route to legal; need to confirm minimal edits.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can either fill SIG Lite or the full SIG depending on your preference — we usually prefill SIG Lite first to speed review and then expand to full SIG if needed.

Clarifying asks for you so we scope the questionnaire properly:
1) Do you require SOC 2 Type II report itself, or will a SOC 2 summary + control mapping suffice for initial evaluation?
2) Is a signed BAA required before we start the security questionnaire, or can it be executed in parallel?
3) For data residency: is production data residency in the EU required, or is export acceptable with standard contractual clauses?
4) Any vendor evidence templates (e.g., your internal ATO checklist) we should align to?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll prefill the SIG Lite with answers for the items we already have and attach the SOC 2 summary. Monica will own evidence collection if you need deeper artifacts.
- If you confirm timeline, we’ll target to return the prefill within 3 business days.

Attachments: 
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (control summary)
- placeholder: SIG_prefill_Redwood_20270215.xlsx (prefill)

Can you confirm preference on SIG Lite vs full SIG and whether a signed BAA is required up front?

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@clearhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope — next steps

Hi Logan — thanks for the clear summary and for taking notes during the call. A few clarifications from our side: 

Answers to your questions:
1) For initial evaluation, a SOC 2 summary + control mapping is acceptable, but the security review board will request the Type II report later in the procurement flow (before final approval).
2) BAA: we prefer to have an executed BAA prior to production access, but it can be signed in parallel while we review the SIG prefill.
3) Data residency: production data for EU patients must remain in the EU. Development/test data can be in the US if anonymized; please call out any subprocessing and data transfer mechanisms.
4) We do not have a single vendor evidence template; the SIG Lite is preferred by our security team as a first pass.

A couple of priority items for the questionnaire: 
- Encryption at rest: we will need the algorithm and whether customer-managed keys (CMKs) via KMS/HSM are supported.
- Access controls: evidence of least privilege/role separation for ops and engineering.
- Logging/audit: retention window and whether logs include user identifiers tied to audit trails.

Timeline: procurement is hoping to close the vendor review in ~2 weeks if possible. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
- provide a BAA template quickly, and
- prefill SIG Lite within 3 business days (preferably with KMS documentation linked)?

If you can send the prefill and SOC summary by end of day Thursday (US PST), I’ll route it to our security reviewer.

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Head of Vendor Risk — ClearHealth Technologies
asha.menon@clearhealth.com

Hi Asha — attaching the SIG Lite prefill and SOC summary per our plan. Quick notes below and next steps.

What’s attached:
- SIG_prefill_Redwood_20270215.xlsx (prefill answers; items marked "LEGAL" need sign-off)
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (control mapping and scope summary)

Short answers to your priority asks:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 with envelope encryption. We support customer-managed keys via supported KMS integrations; details are in the KMS section of the prefill.
- Access controls: role-based access control, least-privilege enforced; example RBAC policy screenshots included in the evidence folder.
- Logging/audit: audit logs retained 12 months by default; configurable retention up to 36 months for enterprise customers. Logs include user identifiers and request traces.
- BAA: Legal is ready to review — can you confirm your preferred BAA template or edits? We will prioritize turnaround once we have your template.

Links / related: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/39124 (HS-39124)

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm whether SIG Lite suffices for initial review; if so, we’ll wait for any follow-up evidence requests and route legal for BAA sign-off in parallel.
2) If you’d like a live 30–45 minute review of the prefill with our security team, we can set that up next week — suggested slots: Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on your side.

Best,
